title: Oracle shadow machine
statement: Given $n\geq 0$, an index $i<n$, and a deterministic machine with $n$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $S$, define a machine with $n+1$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $S\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. Its initial state is the original initial state paired with true. On each transition, it applies the oracle shadow action to the original transition, using the first $n$ scanned work-tape symbols, the Boolean component of the current state, and the scanned symbol on the added tape as the marker.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index among the $n$ work tapes
the original machine has Boolean symbols and state set $S$
